> **Danny Bee:** G307 DCG Formula Increased sensitivity to 514 and 532 I dont think this totally correct , Jeff test it just before presenting his paper and found that it the Increased sensitivity cover the whole curve of normal sensitivity of DCG and not just the green by speeding up the dark-reacton. so it would help the blue end as well as the green

I did'nt actually state that Danny.

It may be true though. Have you tried it in the blue? I did not have a CW blue laser then.

However what I did say was that the high concentration of potassium dichromate in G307 was needed for getting enough 532nm absorption and that a pure grade of sodium dichromate would probably allow us to get higher sensitivity still because we could pack still more in.

However when it comes to making Denisyuks with blue light , concentrations like that would make the film as transparent to blue light as a lump of coal.

Jeff
